review_holds.item: Powered pivot tilt and positive capture
review_holds.finding: Flat LT18 thrust stack penetrates in every ±1° tilt probe.
review_holds.required: A load-rated yaw connection with the required pitch/roll freedoms and positive retention; verify main-frame load introduction.

review_holds.finding: Per-spring static demands vary by axle; rod/chain motion is unfinished.
review_holds.required: Select springs, preload and travel from accepted corner loads and dynamics; resolve axlebox clearances and guide wear surfaces.

review_holds.finding: Static hanging wheelset proxy is only a lower-bound load component.
review_holds.required: Define droop event energy, dynamic separation load, two-restraint load sharing and single-failure case. Use a mechanical load path independent of spring seating; size rod, shoulder, lock, bushing, plate and joints together.

review_holds.finding: Truck-mounted guides now rotate with each powered bogie; LT16/17 fixed-frame details do not transfer.
review_holds.required: Resolve combined traction, braking, side thrust, motor reaction and repeated guide loads. Check bearing/tear-out, bolt slip/preload, weld group, local truck section and fatigue.

review_holds.finding: Static beam stress is not a frame or attachment approval.
review_holds.required: Actual mass/CG, wheel/rail loads, braking/buff/draft, track twist, coupling, truck strength and structural review remain open.

limits: Vertical estimates only. Equal load sharing between the two springs/restraints per axle is assumed. Hanging-load values exclude dynamic amplification, unequal capture and force from rods, chains or bump/rebound impact. No dimensions, material grades, welds, torques or fits are released.
